The 7 Brew Brewista and Scoops Test

New 7 Brew crew — brewistas — take an internal knowledge check during training, covering the menu, the builds and the sizes. This page is a study sheet, not an answer key: we have no access to 7 Brew's internal test, and the questions differ by stand and trainer. What does not differ is the menu, so that is what is worth learning.

If you landed here looking for a Quizlet-style answer set: the test is checked against you building real drinks at the window, so memorising someone else's answers does not get you through the training shift. The tables below are the material the test is drawn from.

Start with the structure

The menu is 8 categories, and almost every question follows from knowing which category a drink belongs to:

CategoryWhat it isItems
7 OriginalsSignature flavoured breves — espresso with half-and-half7
ClassicsStandard espresso drinks: Latte, Mocha, Macchiato, Breve, Cappuccino, Americano, Cold Brew7
7 EnergyFlavoured energy base, no espresso7
7 FizzItalian-soda style, soda water base4
LemonadesFresh lemonade with fruit flavours4
SmoothiesBlended fruit4
ShakesBlended ice cream — the "scoops" side4
Teas, Chai & MatchaBrewed tea, chai and matcha lattes3

These come up most, because they are what the brand is known for. Learn the build line and the name stops being arbitrary:

Customisation you will be asked about

  • Extra shot: add an extra espresso shot
  • Milk alt: oat, coconut & almond
  • Topping: cream, whipped cream or cold foam
  • Flavor: pick a flavour or a few; sugar-free options available
  • Drizzle: white choc | dark choc or caramel
  • Sweetness: 1/4, 1/2, reg, extra

The customization guide has the full syrup and milk list.

Brewista test FAQ

What is the 7 Brew brewista test?

It is the internal knowledge check new 7 Brew crew take during training. Crew members are called brewistas, and the test covers the drink menu, sizes, builds and register basics before you work the window on your own.

What is the 7 Brew scoops test?

Scoops is the same idea applied to the shake and smoothie side of the menu — knowing the builds and the scoop counts that go into each one. Stands use the term interchangeably with the drink test.

Is there an answer key for the 7 Brew test?

Not one we will publish, and not one you should rely on. The test is your employer's internal assessment, it varies by stand and trainer, and it is checked against you actually building drinks. Learning the menu is faster than hunting for answers.

How do I study for the 7 Brew barista test?

Learn the categories first, then the builds inside each one, then the sizes. The menu is structured, not random — once you know that a breve is espresso with half-and-half, most of the 7 Originals follow from their flavour name.

How long is 7 Brew training?

It varies by stand and by how many shifts you pick up, but new brewistas typically train alongside experienced crew for the first week or two before working a lane independently.
